title: ononis tridentata var. intricata
intro: Ononis tridentata var. intricata, commonly known as the spiny restharrow, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Ononis tridentata var. intricata for medicinal purposes.
